name: dvera-mcp
description: Exposes CT's C/C++ verification tools - project setup, analysis, test generation and execution, coverage, reporting - to an MCP client. Requires a local CT 2026.06 or later installation; without one the server reports a single built-in environment check.
long_description:
DVERA hands CT's C/C++ verification tools to an MCP client so the whole loop - creating the project, resolving the toolchain, running analysis, generating and executing tests, reviewing statement/branch/MC-DC coverage, and exporting reports - happens in one conversation.

The server reads the tool catalog shipped with the CT MCP bundle and forwards each call to CT's own command-line entry point. It keeps no process of its own between calls, and it does not bundle or modify any CT code.

CT 2026.06 or later must be installed locally, with a valid licence; the tools act on that installation. Where CT is absent the server still starts and offers dvera_check_environment, a built-in tool that reports what is missing, so it is safe to leave configured on any machine.

ct_home.title: CT installation directory
ct_home.description: Leave empty unless CT was installed somewhere other than the default location.
